items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: To try to emulate, like Charlie Parker, what he’s doing?

ctx.x: Well see it’s kind of funny and maybe notable, and I — I can’t think of how to say it —
To try to emulate, like Charlie Parker, what he’s doing?
Oh well it’s the idea of making up these different lines to fit over changes, chord changes, and also to just play even freer than that — that appealed to me a lot.
